notes.title: Update Notes for Apr 16
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the Arcade mode update!
Here's a small patch to fix a few things based on player feedback:

[b]ENDLESS ENCORE[/b]
[list]
[*]Tentacles can now take damage during Ina's fight (not just Ina)
[*]Added invincibility frames when forced to switch character
[*]Fixed a bug where music would stop when forced to switch character
[*]Fixed a bug where time would be deleted at the start of some bosses (King Crimson style)
[/list]

notes.title: ARCADE MODE UPDATE
notes.content:
Thank you for playing FLARE NUINUI QUEST!

It's been a while since the last update, this one adds the [b]Arcade mode[/b] containing two new challenges:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45235587/19a08e4004ceb0d4a085c1ec4c04221819e29e07.gif[/img]
[h2]FANTASY RUSH[/h2]
Play as Flare against the other Hololive Fantasy members in a fast-paced mini boss rush!
Getting hit won’t knock you out, but it will cost you time. Learn each bosses moves, and watch out for their powerful final attacks!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45235587/e90b77e3fa21cdfab47d9d84a6d96dfcccd7dda7.gif[/img]
[h2]ENDLESS ENCORE[/h2]
Play as Flare, Noel, Pekora and Marine in a giant boss rush!
You are outnumbered so you'll need to manage your health carefully. Keep your team alive to earn a high score!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45235587/7d525136559b75522eaacef9f8753424410fb97c.gif[/img]

A few tips:
[list]
[*]Flare and Noel are invincible when sliding
[*]Noel and Marine can destroy projectiles with their attacks
[*]Pekora's laugh button is useless (...unless?)
[/list]
That's all for now,
don't hesitate to leave some feedback and good luck!

notes.title: Update Notes For Oct 30
notes.content:
Thank you for playing FLARE NUINUI QUEST!
It’s been a week since the game launched so here's some improvements and fixes based on player feedback:

[h2][b]General Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Charged Attacks:[/b] Charged attacks are no longer canceled when taking a hit.
[*][b]Air Vents:[/b] Can now be controlled using the jump button.
[*][b]Credits:[/b] Press [b]A[/b] to speed up the credits sequence.
[*][b]Achievement Count:[/b] Total achievements are now displayed in the menu.
[/list]

[h2][b]Nuinui Quest Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Miko Petals:[/b] Increased petal damage by +1 per hit.
[*][b]Character Switch Button:[/b] New dedicated button for switching characters (Default: [b]Space[/b] on keyboard, [b]Select[/b] on controllers). [u][b]For players who have already played with a controller, you may have to set this manually as select is already in use.[/b][/u]
[*][b]Elevator Intros:[/b] Shortened intro sequences for the Casino and Port elevators.
[/list]

[h2][b]Random Quest Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Shop Pop-up:[/b] A prompt now appears when obtaining a crystal for the first time.
[*][b]Crystal Retention:[/b] Crystals are no longer halved on death.
[*][b]Shop Prices Adjusted:[/b]
  [list]
  [*]+1 Bomb: [b]20 → 10[/b]
  [*]+1 Damage: [b]20 → 15[/b]
  [/list]
[*][b]Final Boss Intro Skip:[/b] The intro is now skipped if you’ve previously faced the final boss and died.
[/list]

[h2][b]Maiden Quest Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Anchor Speed:[/b] Increased by +50%.
[*][b]Port 1:[/b] Reduced difficulty.
[*][b]Final Boss Intro Skip:[/b] The intro is now skipped if you’ve previously faced the final boss and died.
[*][b]Result Screen:[/b] Added after clearing a stage.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Reflected Homing Projectiles:[/b] No longer pass through boss shields.
[*][b]Demon Lord’s Castle:[/b] Several rooms now have ceilings.
[*][b]Timezone Clock:[/b] Disabled when starting the Watame Moto phase.
[*][b]Gamepad Controls:[/b] Settings are now saved properly.
[/list]
